journeys.title: Assure outcome readout — the operator learns what shipped, what was filed, what blocked
journeys.trigger: An item's assure walk produces at least one non-pass scenario verdict
journeys.outcome: The operator can tell, from the packet's first screen and factory status --json, whether the item shipped with known non-blocking fails (each terminating in an open owning item) or was blocked/reworked — and has exactly one next action

journeys.title: Cost breaker decision — the operator meets a parked runaway item and chooses continue, narrow, or defer
journeys.trigger: An item enters an implement round with rework edges at or above the threshold while "cost" is in the configured gates
journeys.outcome: The operator learns from the packet alone what the item has consumed, what it is blocking, and the consequence of each of continue / narrow / defer, and records one with a single command that provably unblocks the item exactly once

journeys.title: Redesign cap decision — the operator meets an item that exhausted its redesign cap and chooses the tradeoff
journeys.trigger: An approach.rejected request arrives when the item's engine-counted approach.rejected edges already equal MAX_APPROACH_REJECTIONS
journeys.outcome: The operator learns from the packet alone what redesigns and rework the item consumed, what the forbidden-approaches record says cannot converge, and records continue/narrow/defer with a single command that provably unblocks exactly once

journeys.title: Bug door intake — a reported defect is routed to /factory:bug, replicated before any fix, and lands visibly on the roadmap
journeys.trigger: A human reports a defect at any intake door (/factory:bug, /factory:add, /factory:do, or a roadmap batch)
journeys.outcome: The defect is filed with its materiality tier and its evidence claim recorded separately, a confirmed repro exists before any fix work, the item appears in docs/factory/roadmap.md and in factory status, and its packet names the depth the item ran at and the intake path it took
